Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND
INITSECTION
DB_Check(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255);
KBSECTION
IF
CharacterUsedSkill(_Player, "Target_Spell", _)
AND
DB_Check(_Player)
THEN
ApplyStatus(_Player, "Target_Status", -1)
DB_Seen(_Player)

IF
Unequipped(_Item, _Character)
AND
HasActiveStatus(_Character, "Target_Status", 1)
THEN
RemoveStatus(_Character, "Target_Status", _Item);
PROC_Target(_Character);
EXITSECTION
NOT DB_Seen(S_Player_Astarion_c7c13742-bacd-460a-8f65-f864fe41f255);
SysCompleteGoal("Init");
ENDEXITSECTION
